originalText: {"recordId":"d12cb6738660f38c0df77d94","country":"FR","sourceId":"FR-portal","sourceName":"BOAMP national procurement notices","sourceUrl":"https://www.boamp.fr/pages/avis/?q=idweb:24-21735","noticeId":"24-21735","procedureId":"d854a29f-3aa2-4e83-97b2-27066df32ce4","title":"Transport collectif d'élèves dans le cadre de sorties scolaires pour les besoins de la COMPA - 4 lots (lots n°4, 5, 6 et 7)","description":"Transport collectif d'élèves dans le cadre de sorties scolaires pour les besoins de la COMPA - 4 lots (lots n°4, 5, 6 et 7) | En 2021, la COMPA a lancé un appel d'offres ouvert relatif au transport collectif de personnes pour les besoins de la COMPA portant sur 10 lots distincts pour une durée de 4 ans. Aujourd'hui, 4 lots (lots 4, 5, 6 et 7) concernés par cet appel d'offres ont atteint ou presque atteint le montant maximum du marché avant l'échéance du marché. Il est donc nécessaire de les relancer pour assurer la continuité des prestations Pour faciliter le suivi des marchés, il est fait le choix de maintenir les mêmes numéros de lots. CNES-CSG intends to renew the system called FASO whose purpose is to edit work request orders for people who have to work on the CSG Space base.
Those work orders are generated from the scheduling and planning tool.

Currently, the system is physically disconnected from the planning tool. This enforce manual exports to specific physical ‘stations’ located at some specific places where each person who is supposed to work on the Space base will retrieve its work order.
When the job is finished, the reporting has to be manually done within the planning tool.

The purpose of the project is to :
•	Automate both import of the work orders and export when the job is completed
•	Allow all industrial partners or temporary workers to access those workorders despite the fact that they are not known on the CNES active directory
•	Allow access to those work orders from mobile devices to facilitate the on site interventions

Delivery will consist in the new FASO system
